purpose: To automate the nightly extraction of tables needed by the analytics vendor into a staging bucket for their warehouse loading

components.name: sync-job
components.evidence: sync-job reads the selected tables from the analytics read replica, writes one extract file per table to the staging bucket, and the Analytics vendor downloads the files from the bucket.

components.name: Analytics vendor
components.evidence: the Analytics vendor downloads the files from the bucket.
